field_principles.field_principles: Explain why each required result field exists.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Disclose whether the result depends on an inference model.
field_principles.duration_s: Record the monotonic wall time used by the precondition check.
field_principles.random_seed: Fix the planned fixture order for reproducible evaluation.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Bind the matrix, source, roadmap, and evaluated rows to one digest.
field_principles.compatibility_matrix: State the maintained agent families, model patterns, and reason codes, or why they are unavailable.
field_principles.rows: Record one result for every pair that the task evaluated.
field_principles.exp6781_reproduced: Show whether the incident pair was rejected for the expected reason.
field_principles.supported_pairs_passed: Show whether every supported fixture passed.
field_principles.cross_family_pairs_rejected: Show whether every cross-family fixture failed closed.
field_principles.unknown_pairs_rejected: Show whether every unknown fixture failed closed.
field_principles.v592_pairs_audited: Show whether every task pair in the required V592 roadmap was audited.
field_principles.dispatch_contract_ready: State the exact readiness decision required before activation.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: Name each blocking precondition and its observed value.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: Prevent a static contract check from being described as an independent oracle.
field_principles.verdict_class: Classify the terminal outcome with the closed result enum.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Give a terminal result with the required trusted prefix.

inference_substrate: static local filesystem inspection, no inference model
